summary: Frontend E2E testing (Honda Safe Journey) — authenticated via seeded Mongo sessions (user + dealer). Executed the full user flow: Landing -> Dashboard -> Onboarding -> Bluetooth -> Wallet -> Contacts -> Journey Plan -> Live Journey (all 3 simulations + SOS trigger) -> Claim, plus Dealer Command Center and role gating. 21/22 checks passed. Only the auto-arrival wait (~5 min at ~650ms/step over 448 route points) didn't finish inside the test window; the arrival modal itself renders correctly when reached (verified in a shorter 0-km run, screenshot captured).

design_issues.screen: All Leaflet maps (StartJourney, LiveJourney, Dealer incident modal)
issues: CartoDB basemap tiles are rendering the placeholder 'API KEY REQUIRED / carto.com/basemaps/apikey' watermark. The map, markers and route polyline still render (Leaflet + interaction work), but the underlying tiles are unusable in production. Either switch LeafletMap.jsx to OpenStreetMap tiles (https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png) or provide a valid CartoDB / MapTiler API key.
Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add <DialogDescription> for accessibility.

action_items: Replace Carto basemap URL with OSM tiles (or add API key) in src/components/LeafletMap.jsx — map currently displays 'API KEY REQUIRED' watermark on every screen.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Dialogs in Wallet add-document and Start-Journey precheck to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: LeafletMap uses Carto basemap without API key — visible watermark on production URL; either point to OSM tiles or wire the key from env.

StartJourney presets: both A and B use the same preset list; when a preset is clicked before the other side is set, both can become identical (0-km route). Not a bug per se, but consider disabling identical A/B or showing an inline warning before enabling Start.

LiveJourney auto-advance interval (~650ms) on a 448-point OSRM polyline makes the full simulated journey ~5 minutes, hard to reach programmatically without pause manipulation. Consider a 'jump to end' dev shortcut or expose a faster step for QA.
Radix Dialog missing DialogDescription causes accessibility warnings across the app.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (21/22 UI checks; arrival modal verified in a separate 0-km run but auto-arrival timing on the 23.7 km route exceeded the test window)
